pinned.label: Pinned apps
pinned.description: One per line: key, app_id, then the command to launch it (defaults to the app_id), e.g. "z zen-beta". A pinned app's windows are labelled with its key; when it isn't running, the key launches it.

hint_chars.label: Label letters
hint_chars.description: Letters used to label the other windows, best first. Pinned keys are left out.
